ruleDefinitions.name: Windows Defender Configuration Changes
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious changes to the Windows Defender configuration Note: Unmapped fields: NewValue

sequences.query: (event_id = 5007 AND (NewValue = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\ Defender\\\\DisableAntiSpyware\\ .*") OR NewValue = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\ Defender\\\\Scan\\\\DisableRemovableDriveScanning\\ .*") OR NewValue = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\ Defender\\\\Scan\\\\DisableScanningMappedNetworkDrivesForFullScan\\ .*") OR NewValue = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\ Defender\\\\SpyNet\\\\DisableBlockAtFirstSeen\\ .*") OR NewValue = RGX(".*\\\\Real\\-Time\\ Protection\\\\SpyNetReporting\\ .*")))
